en: There is a certain person who, regarding teachings unheard before, awakens to the truths by himself, and therein attains omniscience and mastery over the powers.
There is a certain person who, regarding teachings unheard before, awakens to the truths by himself, but does not therein attain omniscience nor mastery over the powers.
There is a certain person who, regarding teachings not heard before, awakens to the truths by himself and, in this very life, makes an end of suffering and attains the perfection of a disciple.

There is a certain person who, regarding teachings not heard before, awakens to the truths by himself and, in this very life, makes an end of suffering, but does not attain the perfection of a disciple.

There is a certain person who, regarding teachings unheard before, does not personally awaken to the truths, yet does not make an end of suffering in this very life; he is a non-returner, one who will not come back to this state of being.

There is a certain person who, regarding teachings unheard before, does not personally awaken to the truths, yet does not make an end of suffering in this very life; he is a once-returner, one who will come back to this state of being.
This is the group of six.
